CustomNotifActionDef.name: CustomNotifActionDef
CustomNotifActionDef.description: Represents the metadata associated with a mobile action group notification definition.

ActionName.description: Name of the mobile action group. Use a unique name per custom notification type. The field can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores.

ActionOrder.description: Order in which this action appears in the mobile action group. Select a number between 1 and 3, as there are 3 maximum actions in a group.

TargetId.description: This relationship field is the name of the ApexClass that implements handling of the action. TargetId is used only when the ActionType is set to NotificationApiAction.
